post.headline: Make new tips visible to the right inbox
post.subtext: The onboarding step asks where Hush Line should send new tips so recipients can set email delivery before people rely on the tip line.
post.image_alt_text: Hush Line daily social asset showing the desktop onboarding screen for notifications. The screen says "Where should we send new tips?" and includes an Email Address field, illustrating the plain principle that sensitive reports need a clear path to timely review.

social.linkedin:
A whistleblowing process needs a clear path from first message to review. For recipients and staff, that starts with deciding where new tips should go.

Learn more at https://hushline.app.

post.rationale: Selected the recipient-shared onboarding notifications screenshot because it supports the required ISO 37002 principle format through timely handling of reports. The archive recently used a settings notifications workflow teardown on 2026-06-05, so this draft avoids forwarding-rule language and focuses on the setup decision shown in the screenshot: choosing where new tips should be sent before a public tip line is used by sources.
